name: WeBridge
backstory: A student-built platform that helps early-stage Indian founders discover the government schemes, funding and mentors they qualify for — swipe to shortlist, then pitch a mentor. Recently registered but not yet DPIIT-recognised, looking for a grant to build out the platform.
topNeed: a grant to build our prototype, and a mentor who has built a startup marketplace

name: AgriSense
backstory: A DPIIT-recognised agritech startup in Bengaluru selling soil-sensor kits to farmers for two years, hunting for non-dilutive grants to expand to new districts.

name: MediQueue
backstory: Two doctors in Hyderabad with an idea for an OPD queue-management app — nothing registered yet, just exploring what support exists before quitting their jobs.

name: LearnLoop
backstory: A DPIIT-recognised edtech company in Delhi with 40,000 paying students, preparing to raise a proper VC round and wanting to get compliance in order first.
